2607.18199.title: PPL-Factory: Task-Aware and Budget-Aware Data Selection from Language Modeling to Reasoning
2607.18199.paper_summary: Not all training samples contribute equally to large language model fine-tuning. Selecting informative training samples can reduce the computational cost while preserving downstream performance. Many existing data selection methods rely on indirect heuristics, such as data quality, diversity or reasoning trace length. However, the effectiveness of these fixed criteria is task-dependent and difficult to generalize across diverse downstream tasks. Perplexity-based data selection provides a simple and model-aware solution to estimate the sample difficulty, but existing approaches typically score the entire training sequence and ignore the difference in learning objectives of language modeling and reasoning tasks. In this paper, we propose PPL-Factory, a simple and interpretable data selection framework that combines task-aware perplexity-based scores and data budget-aware selection criteria. Experiments on GSM8K demonstrate that PPL-Factory outperforms other state-of-the-art data selection methods using only $1\%$ of the training set. With $10\%$ of the data, PPL-Factory exceeds full-data fine-tuning accuracy by 0.9 on GSM8K and 4.8 on MATH. Overall, our results demonstrate that task-aware and budget-aware perplexity-based selection provides an effective and applicable approach for efficient fine-tuning.
2607.18199.paper_summary_zh: 並非所有的訓練樣本對大型語言模型的微調貢獻相同。<lb/>選擇有信息量的訓練樣本可以在保留下游性能的同時減少計算成本。<lb/>許多現有的數據選擇方法依賴於間接啟發式，例如數據質量、多樣性或推理痕跡長度。<lb/>然而，這些固定標準的有效性依賴於任務，並且難以在多樣的下游任務中進行概括。<lb/>基於困惑度的數據選擇提供了一種簡單且模型感知的解決方案來估計樣本的難度，但現有方法通常對整個訓練序列進行評分，並忽略了語言建模和推理任務的學習目標之間的差異。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了PPL-Factory，一個簡單且可解釋的數據選擇框架，結合了任務感知的基於困惑度的分數和數據預算感知的選擇標準。<lb/>在GSM8K上的實驗表明，PPL-Factory在僅使用$1\%$的訓練集的情況下超越了其他最先進的數據選擇方法。<lb/>使用$10\%$的數據時，PPL-Factory在GSM8K上超過了全數據微調的準確率0.9，在MATH上超過了4.8。<lb/>總體而言，我們的結果表明，任務感知和預算感知的基於困惑度的選擇提供了一種有效且適用於高效微調的方法。
